name: WebStyle Personal Coupons for WooCommerce
author: christiann

sections.description:
WebStyle Personal Coupons lets you run coupon campaigns. A campaign gives every customer their own code, or one shared code with limits, and groups into categories so you can see what each campaign brought in.

Personal codes

  • One code per e-mail address and campaign. Asking again for the same address returns the same code, so a resent e-mail never hands out a second code.
  • Codes can be bound to the recipient’s e-mail address.
  • Set how many codes a campaign may issue, and how many times each code may be used.
  • Valid until a fixed date, or for a number of days after the code is issued.
  • Readable codes with your own prefix, without characters that are easily mistaken (0/O, 1/I).

Shared codes

  • One code you choose yourself, for example FOD20 for every member of a club.
  • Limit the total number of uses (“the first 100”) and the uses per e-mail address.

For every campaign

  • Percentage or fixed discount on the products.
  • Decide what the code covers: only or not for specific products, categories, tags and attribute values such as Colour: Red (also on variations), and whether sale items get the discount.
  • The discount lands only on the covered items, for a fixed amount too, so a cart with other items can still use the code.
  • Limit the code to certain countries, or exclude countries, by shipping or billing address.
  • Minimum and maximum cart amount.
  • Start and end date.
  • Categories, for example “Winter sale”, to compare campaigns over the years.
  • A use is counted when the order is placed and given back if the order is cancelled, refunded or fails.
  • Works with the classic checkout and the Cart and Checkout blocks, and with High-Performance Order Storage.

Campaign screen

Under Marketing → Discount codes the overview shows the codes issued and redeemed, what customers saved and the revenue for the last week, month, 3 months or any interval, per category and campaign, with a chart and a CSV export. A short guide walks you through a new campaign in four steps and sums up the rules in plain words before you save. Every product, category, tag, attribute value and country can be picked from a list you can browse and search, and a new category can be created right where you choose it. The discount step shows how WooCommerce calculates shipping in your shop with the code: your free-shipping thresholds per zone, whether they are measured before or after the discount, and an example with the discount you entered. Each campaign has its own page with the codes issued and used, what customers saved and the revenue from orders with a code. Paste e-mail addresses or upload a CSV file to issue personal codes, and download all codes as CSV.

The discount step mentions three of our paid plugins where they answer the question at hand: WebStyle Accounting Sync under the discount (bookkeeping), Checkout Optimizer Pro under shipping (free shipping with a code) and WebStyle Mail under sending personal codes. Each mention can be closed for good and is not shown when that plugin is active.

Codes are kept in the plugin’s own database tables instead of as WooCommerce coupon posts, so thousands of personal codes do not slow down your shop.

Sending codes

Other plugins can issue codes through a filter. WebStyle Mail uses it to put a personal code in each newsletter.

For developers

Issue or fetch a recipient’s personal code in a campaign:

$code = apply_filters( 'cnwscoupons_issue_code', '', array( 'campaign' => 'spring-offer', 'email' => 'customer@example.com', 'source' => 'my-plugin' ) );

The filter returns an empty string when the campaign does not exist, has ended, has issued all its codes, has a shared code, or the e-mail address is invalid.

List active campaigns with personal codes (slug => name):

$campaigns = apply_filters( 'cnwscoupons_active_campaigns', array() );

Add-ons can change the WooCommerce coupon a code produces with the cnwscoupons_coupon_data filter, store their own settings on a campaign (cnwscoupons_extension_sanitizers), add fields to the campaign guide with the JavaScript filter cnwscoupons.guide.shipping, and look up a code’s campaign with cnwscoupons_campaign_for_code.

WP-CLI: wp webstyle-coupons create-campaign, list-campaigns, issue and codes.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New, or upload the ZIP file, and activate it.
  3. Go to Marketing → Coupon campaigns and click Create campaign.
  4. For personal codes, open the campaign and paste e-mail addresses or upload a CSV file. A shared code is ready as soon as the campaign is saved.
sections.faq:
Do the codes appear under Marketing → Coupons?

No. They are served to WooCommerce on the fly from the plugin’s own tables, so they do not appear in WooCommerce’s coupon list. The plugin shows them per campaign instead.

What happens to a code when an order is cancelled?

The code is released and can be used again until it expires.

Does the plugin contact any external service?

No. Everything stays in your shop’s database, and the admin screen loads no external scripts or fonts.

What personal data does the plugin store?

The e-mail address of each recipient of a personal code, and for each use the order number, e-mail address, country, discount and order total. The codes and uses of an e-mail address can be exported and erased with WordPress’ own tools under Tools → Export Personal Data and Erase Personal Data, and the plugin adds a suggested text to your privacy policy.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

Campaigns, codes and their history are kept, so you do not lose your figures by mistake. To remove them when the plugin is deleted, set the option cnwscoupons_delete_data_on_uninstall to yes first, for example with wp option update cnwscoupons_delete_data_on_uninstall yes.

Can a code give free shipping?

The free plugin never changes shipping: the discount is taken off the products, and the guide shows how WooCommerce calculates shipping in your shop when the code is used. Free shipping with a code, a discount on shipping and a free-shipping threshold measured before the discount come with Checkout Optimizer Pro, which adds these settings to the campaign guide.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • First release on WordPress.org.
  • Campaigns with categories, personal codes (one per e-mail address) and shared codes with limits, restrictions on products, categories, tags, attributes, countries, sale items and cart amount, virtual WooCommerce coupons, use counting on order status, overview with period and category filters, campaign screen with guide, code issuing and CSV export, WordPress privacy export and erasure, and WP-CLI commands.

short_description: Unique one-use WooCommerce coupon codes for each recipient, with expiry and an overview of what was redeemed.
